sentences.text:
Author: Hiranmay Bhattacharyya Bench: Hiranmay Bhattacharyya ML 04.03.25 57 Sws.M  CO 453 of 2025  Arnima Mordyana @ Pramanik  vs.
 Subhash Mordyana  Mr. Abhinaba Das  ...for the petitioner

This application under Section 24 of the Code of Civil Procedure is at the instance of the wife for transfer of Matrimonial Suit No. 731 of 2024 pending before the learned Judge, Family Court,
Paschim Bardhaman to the Court of learned Additional District Judge, Bishnupur, Bankura.

It has been specifically stated in paragraph 6 of the application that an application under Section 125 of the Code of Criminal Procedure is pending before the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate,
Bishnupur, Bankura being Misc. Case No. 169 of 2023.

In paragraph 7 of the said application it has been stated that Bishnupur Police Station Case No. 9 of 2024 dated 17th January, 2024 under Sections 498A/406/414/448/379 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 3 /4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961 is pending before the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Bishnupur, District- Bankura.
The petitioner is directed to serve a copy of this application upon the opposite party/husband by registered post with Acknowledgement Due and file affidavit-of-service on the next date.

There shall be an order of stay of all further proceedings in Matrimonial Suit No. 731 of 2024 pending before the learned Judge, Family Court, Paschim Bardhaman to the Court of learned Additional District Judge, Bishnupur, Bankura till the end of June, 2025 or until further orders,
whichever is earlier.
List this matter under the heading 'Motion' in the Combined Monthly List of June, 2025.
